description: This file defines a React component named VectorStoreViewer that displays detailed information about vector store requests and their search results, including request metadata, timing, scoring, and content. It manages UI state for expand/collapse sections and formats timestamps and durations.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Converts a timestamp number into a locale-specific date-time string.

methods.name: calculateDuration
methods.description: Calculates the duration between start and end timestamps and formats it in milliseconds.

methods.name: toggleResult
methods.description: Toggles the expanded/collapsed state of a specific result within a request.
